subject: AWS listing handoff: SKU parity, usage TTL policy, and fulfillment webhook cadence
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@amazon.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing handoff: initial SKU + retention questions

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this on. Per our earlier call, CloudOps (your SI partner) and AWS Partnerships need a short handoff packet before we kick off the metering & fulfillment integration. Two quick items blocking the seller onboarding checklist: 

1) SKU parity: We need a single CSV with canonical SKUs and display names. Please confirm whether your internal sku_id maps 1:1 to the marketplace sku, or if we should treat groups (e.g., developer/prod bundles) as separate marketplace SKUs.

2) Usage TTL / retention: AWS requires documented retention for usage events (how long you keep raw events vs aggregated counts). Can you provide the retention windows and the default TTL applied to ingested events (in days)?

I attached a template CSV (sku_mapping_v2.csv) and a draft webhook schema (fulfillment_webhook_schema_v1.json) to align fields.

Proposed next steps:
- You review the CSV and confirm mapping decisions by next Tue 11/2.
- CloudOps will validate webhook field names and send a test event to the sandbox URL.

CCing Ravi (CloudOps) to align on test cadence.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Partner Solutions, AWS Marketplace

Attachment stubs: sku_mapping_v2.csv (CSV), fulfillment_webhook_schema_v1.json (JSON)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@amazon.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Ravi Menon <ravi@cloudops.example.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing handoff: initial SKU + retention questions

Alyssa — thanks, this is helpful. Quick answers and open questions below.

SKU parity:
- Our internal sku_id is currently the unit of billing and maps 1:1 to the product feature set. We do have "bundles" implemented at the UI-layer but for metering we prefer 1 marketplace SKU per sku_id (simplifies entitlement checks).
- Action: I attached a filled SKU column in your CSV with our sku_id and a recommended marketplace_sku. Please treat the bundle_display_name column as UI-only.

Usage TTL / retention:
- Raw token-level events: 30 days
- Aggregated hourly counters (per-customer): retained 730 days (2 years)
- For compliance evidence we can retain anonymized aggregates indefinitely but raw logs will be purged at 30d.

Webhook & fulfillment cadence questions:
- Do you require the webhook to include both "usage_record_id" and an immutable "metering_id"? Our current schema includes a request_id but not a separate metering_id.
- Sandbox URL for testing? We prefer AWS-provided sandbox endpoint; if AWS can't provide one, CloudOps will host a temporary endpoint.

I'll loop in Kimberly and Neha to confirm the CSV and retention statements officially for the legal/ops checklist.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing handoff: initial SKU + retention questions

Markus / Alyssa — confirming retention language and adding a small clarification for procurement: we separate retention for three classes: 

- Raw event logs (per-token or per-request telemetry): 30 days, scope: debugging only; not used for billing after aggregation.
- Billing-grade aggregates (hourly customer counters): 730 days; used as canonical source of truth for invoices and entitlement reconciliation.
- Evidence & audit exports for AWS or customer audits: exported on request and stored for up to 7 years in encrypted archival buckets (access-controlled).

Attached: SaaS_Listing_SOW_v1.pdf (high level SOW paragraph included for marketplace onboarding).

Kimberly — can you confirm if this retention wording is acceptable for the AWS legal ops checklist? If not, we should flag the specific export retention for customers who request it.

Thanks,
Neha

Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — this looks good and clears the immediate marketplace checklist items. A few remaining logistics and timelines: 

- DocuSign: I'll route the minimal SOW and the marketplace listing agreement today (link below). Expect signatures from AWS side by EOD Thu 11/4 if no redlines.
- Sandbox testing: Ravi, please send a single POST to the sandbox endpoint with the sample webhook payload by 11/5 so we can validate field mapping. If you need an AWS sandbox URL, reply to this thread and I'll provision one.
- Metering ID: AWS prefers an immutable metering_id in addition to request_id to support dedupe for replay windows — can your webhook include both? If not, we can accept request_id plus a timestamp-based dedupe but will need a longer replay window.

Next steps (owner):
- Markus: upload the filled SKU mapping CSV to the Drive link by 11/2 (owner: markus_klein).
- Ravi: send test event to sandbox by 11/5 (owner: ravi@cloudops.example.com).
- Kimberly/Neha: confirm legal/ops retention wording by 11/3.

DocuSign (powerform): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-123
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2c3SkuMap

Appreciate the quick turnaround — once those items are green we schedule the production switch with a one-hour maintenance window.

Best,
Alyssa
AWS Marketplace Partnerships
